dedupe_keys.name: traffic flow a13 rotterdam delft shoulder open 2008 04 25

description:
This dataset group records traffic observation with the shoulder lane open on 25 April 2008. S.P.(Serge) Hoogendoorn deposited the resources in 4TU.ResearchData for TU Delft, Faculty of Civil Engineering and Geosciences, Transport and Planning. The parent deposit contains a plain-text session log and a KML file for the A13 between exits 10 and 11. Its raw 2.2 member contains 11 ZIP image archives, a settings text file and location KML. Its stabilized 2.2 member contains 11 ZIP image archives, results and alignment-trace text, location KML and a WMV preview.

The raw and stabilized members locate observation at kilometre 15.6, longitude 4.4097 and latitude 51.9589, in the Netherlands. Each ZIP is described as containing approximately 2,000 PNG images. Pixel resolution, frame interval and text field definitions are not stated. Temporal coverage is the observation date; publication was on 14 October 2010.

Access is through three distinct public repository deposits and their metadata APIs. The licence is 4TU General Terms of Use; cost is not established. No embargo is stated. The observations and session context can support calibration of road traffic-flow simulations. The stabilized member explicitly derives from the raw member and a separately registered lens calibration image. These are distinct component identities within one observation event; byte equivalence is unproved. This group relates to the catalogued 2007 motorway series. File descriptors were checked without opening any files. Data quality and executable analysis workflows remain unverified.
